document.title: Confirming the Active Deck App restarts it
document.summary: Confirming the active row on the Shell Home Screen now goes through the same activate path as any other row, which requests a Deck App Runtime Restart and hides the Shell. The footer hint and the glossary say so.
document.why: After the Deck App Failure Screen, the only way to retry was to activate another Deck App and switch back, and a single-app device had no way out ([issue](source:s1)).

sources.title: Shell cannot restart the Active Deck App, so recovering from the Failure Screen needs a second app
sources.gist: Make confirming the Active Deck App in the Shell perform a Deck App Runtime Restart; update the Shell glossary entries.

groups.title: Confirm on the active row restarts
groups.why: The issue asks that confirming the Active Deck App perform a Deck App Runtime Restart ([issue](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `shell_poll_system_input` drops the `!pkg->is_active` guard, so `activate_package` calls `package_library_set_active` on the already-active package and sets `request_runtime_restart`, which `main.c` already handles by stopping and restarting the JS runtime.
lookFor: `package_library_set_active` on the active package rewrites the persisted active state with the same name each time; the harness case only proves that this succeeds and keeps `is_active`, not the Shell input path.
The Shell message reads `Restarted <package>.` instead of `Activated <package>.` when the confirmed row was already active; it is visible the next time the Shell opens.

groups.title: Footer hint names the restart
groups.why: Without a hint, the checkmark cell on the active row gives no sign that confirming it does anything.
groups.summary: `shell_render` sets `restart_focused` while the active row's first cell has focus, and `shell_draw_footer_hint` then reads `Confirm: restart`.

groups.title: Glossary lines
groups.why: The issue asks to update the Shell glossary entries ([issue](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `Deck App Runtime Restart` gains the Shell confirm as a trigger, and `Shell Home Screen` says what confirming a package and the Active Deck App does.

commits.subject: feat(shell): confirming the Active Deck App restarts it
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Confirming the active row on the Shell Home Screen now runs the same activate path as any other row, so it requests a Deck App Runtime Restart, hides the Shell and clears the Deck App Failure Screen. The footer hint reads "Confirm: restart" while that cell has focus.

Fixes #108
